ABOUT
A personal blog and playground for statistical and geospatial analyses – and a home for other random explorations and poorly researched topics.

Author

Hi, my name is Mel — I am an Applied Economist turned Geospatial Data Scientist (yes, around that time when global model simulations required distributed loads) – I am passionate about ZERO nonsense, equitable and sustainable policy making that truly empowers everyone’s life in full respect of planetary boundaries.

As a consultant, designer, and instructor, I specialize in helping research teams and businesses effectively harness data, build models, and communicate insights through engaging stories and visuals

I code mostly in R, Python, JavaScript and D3.js. Check out my full bio for contact details.

Services

I provide a variety of services catered to geospatial and remote sensing data:

Geospatial and Remote Sensing Analysis

Machine learning model development and inference for geospatial applications

I offer services in developing predictive models for geospatial applications. Including, but not limited to, retrieval models for multi- and hyperspectral satellite and airborne sensors, as well as multivariate prediction models for ecosystem assessment and climate projections.

Software Development

Software development, data pipelines & cloud infrastructure for scalable geo-applications. Tailored software development and implementation services for the efficient processing and analysis of large-scale geospatial and remote sensing datasets.

Data Visualization

Interactive visualization solutions.
